results.reason: Learn latest linked version is 2025-03-01; REST stable inventory/README has newer stable 2026-07-15, equal to current. Exact REST schemas 2025-03-01, 2026-03-15, and 2026-07-15 agree on all used fields. Learn 2026-07-15 page is unavailable (404), so the explicit source-version discrepancy is retained; no newer REST GA exists.
results.migration: 現在値2026-07-15は固定REST repositoryの最新stableであり、更新候補なし。Learn selectorの最新linked version 2025-03-01はより古い。両REST schemaのused fieldsは同一。kind/sku name/tierはstring型でenumがないため、個別SKU提供可否はsubscription照会なしでは検証対象外。

usage.label: name
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /name is the required REST path parameter `name`, not request body. REST constrains it as string without a published pattern/length; appServicePlanName is truncated to at most 40 chars by the Bicep source.

usage.label: location
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /location maps to REST location string. The module receives main location (default japaneast); schema imposes no enum or additional field constraint.

usage.label: tags
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /tags maps to an object with string additionalProperties. Main passes {'azd-env-name': environment}, so this is a string-valued map; module default {} also conforms.

usage.label: kind
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /kind maps to a REST string. Literal 'functionapp' is type-compatible; schema has no enum to constrain supported resource-kind values.

usage.label: sku
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /sku maps to the REST SkuDescription object; name and tier members are strings, with no required list or enum in the schema.

usage.label: name
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /sku/name maps to string with no schema enum. Literal 'FC1' is type-compatible; provider-specific offer availability is not checked by the public schema and no Azure query was performed.

usage.label: tier
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /sku/tier maps to string with no schema enum. Literal 'FlexConsumption' is type-compatible; provider-specific offer availability is not checked by the public schema and no Azure query was performed.

usage.label: properties
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties maps to AppServicePlanProperties object; the supplied reserved member is checked below.

usage.label: reserved
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties/reserved maps to boolean. Literal true matches the REST description for a Linux App Service plan.

current.analysis: Pinned REST README tag package-2026-07 maps to stable/2026-07-15/openapi.json; the full stable path inventory has 2026-07-15 as its latest version. This exact current schema defines the AppServicePlan request model and every used field. The version-specific Learn page for 2026-07-15 returned 404; this absence is recorded, not treated as a schema failure because exact REST source is available.

ga.analysis: REST latest stable is 2026-07-15, same as current. Learn latest page links 2025-03-01; its exact version page and matching REST schema were also checked and have the same used-field contract. Learn and REST version listings differ; no timing explanation is inferred.

breaking.analysis: Learn change log through 2025-03-01 adds plan identity/install-script/network-related properties; none of the used fields are changed. Current REST 2026-07-15 and preceding 2026-03-15 OpenAPI definitions for used fields are identical.
